runs.reason: BYOXPC investigation receipts: signing, environment observation limits, entitlement effects, ad-hoc runtime control, verification boundaries and respawn behavior; manual observations with verified cleanup.
Three partial BYOXPC consumer workflows: specimen transfer, exec helpers and repeated use, including independent effects after a client timeout; all owned installations and fixtures cleaned up.
BYOXPC remediation baseline: the three registered regressions (false-valued selection key, recursive verification, worker entitlement read-back) recorded red on the starting commit.
BYOXPC remediation timing measurement before and after the generated plist's ThrottleInterval; owned installations removed with absence verified.
BYOXPC remediation Group 1 offline gates: Rust unit batch with the additive envelope shape golden, rustfmt and the fake-tool ownership controls.

BYOXPC remediation Group 1 live gates: entitlement read-back promoted, BBX-001/002, external-auth and registry recovery under the signed build; the dossier witness met the verify host's retirement race.

BYOXPC remediation Group 1: ownership controls with the fake verify PID and the dossier witness after the session helper waits for the verify host to retire; the checker's held-request length still counted selector fields.
BYOXPC remediation Group 1 live gates: both dossier witness cases pass once the checker strips selector fields from the held-request length.

BYOXPC remediation Group 2 gates under recursive verification: registry recovery, external-auth, entitlement read-back and BBX-001 pass; the first validate report also listed the host because a recursive verify of a bundle's main executable repeats the bundle verdict.
BYOXPC remediation Group 2: the offline verification control promoted (install refuses, validate reports bundle and worker) beside codesign.preflight on the rebuilt app.

BYOXPC remediation Group 3 gates, first run: the promoted Rust reds, the Rust batch, the fake-tool and verification controls pass; two live installs were refused already_ran by orphaned clients that reached the fresh host before verify (unified-log receipts quoted in the plan), and the dossier checker lacked the granted key.
BYOXPC remediation Group 3 live gates: dossier witness, entitlement read-back and entitlement transfer pass in the previously failing order, with a process snapshot before each verify.
BYOXPC remediation Group 4 gates with the generated plist's one-second ThrottleInterval: single-use with plist-derived waits, BBX-002, registry recovery and the Rust batch.
BYOXPC remediation Group 5: source drift, limits, contract and architecture checks and a smoke run against the regenerated documents.
BYOXPC remediation final gate: the default battery, 167 of 167 cases, against the signed build stamped v0.2.6-38-g0865136.

BYOXPC remediation final gate, first opt-in run: all 17 runner_byoxpc cases pass; the BYOXPC dossier witness met the verified host still retiring because the session helper had waited on the worker's PID (the served reply's pid), not the host's.

BYOXPC remediation final gate, opt-in rerun after the session helper waits for the host launchd lists: fake-tool ownership controls, dossier witness, entitlement read-back and transfer, single-use and BBX-001 pass.
